summary: This note is a table of picks from the 1999 Major League Baseball draft, listing each pick's player, drafting team, position and school. It covers high school and college players selected by teams including the Tampa Bay Devil Rays, Florida Marlins, Detroit Tigers and St. Louis Cardinals. The note is partial: the first four picks show only player names, and the table is cut off after pick 30.
one_line: Partial list of first-round picks in the 1999 Major League Baseball draft, with players, teams, positions and schools.
key_facts: The note lists first-round picks of the 1999 Major League Baseball draft in columns for pick, player, team, position and school.
Josh Hamilton is listed first, drafted by the Tampa Bay Devil Rays as an OF from Athens Drive HS (Raleigh, North Carolina).
Josh Beckett is listed next, drafted by the Florida Marlins from Spring HS (Spring, Texas).
Eric Munson was drafted by the Detroit Tigers from the University of Southern California.
Corey Myers was drafted by the Arizona Diamondbacks as a SS from Desert Vista HS (Phoenix, Arizona).
B.J. Garbe was pick 5, drafted by the Minnesota Twins as an OF and P from Moses Lake HS (Moses Lake, Washington).
Ben Sheets was pick 10, drafted by the Milwaukee Brewers from Northeast Louisiana University.
Barry Zito was pick 9, drafted by the Oakland Athletics from the University of Southern California.
Brett Myers was pick 12, drafted by the Philadelphia Phillies from Englewood Senior HS (Jacksonville, Florida).
Rick Asadoorian was pick 17, drafted by the Boston Red Sox as an OF from Northbridge HS (Whitinsville, Massachusetts).
Alex Ríos was pick 19, drafted by the Toronto Blue Jays as an OF from San Pedro Martin HS (Guaynabo, PR).
Kurt Ainsworth was pick 24, drafted by the San Francisco Giants from Louisiana State University.
David Walling was pick 27, drafted by the New York Yankees from the University of Arkansas.
Omar Ortíz was pick 29, drafted by the San Diego Padres from the University of Texas - Pan American.
Chance Caple was pick 30, the last listed, drafted by the St. Louis Cardinals from Texas A&M University.
